# StopPaging

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders as much of its child as fits on the current page and discards the rest, instead of continuing onto further pages.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `PaginationWrapperBase`.
